panels.title: mcp_requests_total
panels.description: MCP requests by method and outcome.

panels.title: mcp_request_duration_seconds
panels.description: End-to-end MCP request duration.

panels.title: mcp_tool_calls_total
panels.description: Tool invocations by tool and outcome.

panels.title: mcp_tool_duration_seconds
panels.description: Tool invocation duration.

panels.title: mcp_tool_errors_total
panels.description: Tool errors broken down by error code.

panels.title: mcp_tool_inflight
panels.description: Tool invocations currently in flight.

panels.title: mcp_tool_queue_depth
panels.description: Queue depth per bulkhead. Real values since #43; every configured bulkhead publishes zero at startup so an idle group shows an idle panel rather than a blank one.

panels.title: mcp_policy_decisions_total
panels.description: Policy decisions by phase and decision.

panels.title: mcp_upstream_duration_seconds
panels.description: Upstream call duration by executor type.

panels.title: mcp_circuit_breaker_state
panels.description: Circuit breaker state. v0.2 emits a placeholder "default" breaker; Epic #3 populates real ones.

panels.title: mcp_output_bytes
panels.description: Serialized output size per tool.

panels.title: mcp_registry_reload_total
panels.description: Registry reloads by outcome. `error_class` splits a benign superseded reload from a real failure (#37 QA note).

panels.title: mcp_registry_operations
panels.description: Operation count in the live registry. Deliberately unlabelled (#136): the registry hash that labelled it is unbounded, and truncating it bounded only its width.

panels.title: mcp_bulkhead_rejected_total
panels.description: Calls rejected because a bulkhead queue was full (#43). Counts QUEUE_FULL only — a caller that cancelled while queued is not load being shed, and folding the two together would invert the diagnosis during a burst of client disconnects.

panels.title: mcp_retry_attempts_total
panels.description: Retried attempts by tool and the outcome of that retry (#45). Counts RETRIES only, not the initial attempt — every call already has an initial attempt in mcp_tool_calls_total, so counting it again here would make the retry rate unreadable against a baseline of 1.

panels.title: mcp_retry_exhausted_total
panels.description: Calls that ran out of retry budget, labelled by the error finally returned (#45). Distinguishes "retried and still failed" from "failed once and was not eligible", which look identical in mcp_tool_errors_total.

panels.title: mcp_audit_appends_total
panels.description: Audit records written, by sink and whether the write succeeded (#48).

panels.title: mcp_audit_buffer_size
panels.description: Events buffered in memory per sink (#48). A gauge sitting near the configured bound means dispatch is being back-pressured by audit — intended behaviour, but not a state to leave running.

panels.title: mcp_audit_dropped_total
panels.description: Audit records DISCARDED because the buffer overflowed in drop mode (#48). Any non-zero value means the deployment is configured to violate the audit delivery guarantee — §48 requires this to be alertable and its loudness un-suppressable.

panels.title: mcp_redaction_hits_total
panels.description: Redactions applied, by rule and observable surface (#49). Lets an operator see which rules are firing and where — a rule that never fires is either dead or guarding something that stopped happening, and both are worth knowing.
